row_actions.visibility: visibility:hidden by default — visibility:visible on tr:hover. Space always reserved so row height never jumps.
row_actions.rule: Never use display:none on .row-actions — causes row height jump on hover. Use visibility:hidden instead.

pagination.row_count: Always show 'Showing X–Y of Z' left of pagination

empty_state.heading: No Data… For Now!
empty_state.subtext: No records match your current filters. Try adjusting your search.
empty_state.rule: Keep <thead> and pagination visible. No Refresh button. Never use 🚧 here.
empty_state.example_html:
🚦
No Data… For Now!
No records match your current filters.

datatable.description: Extended table pattern for server-driven, paginated, and expandable data. Wraps ds-table with additional interaction layers. Use for PAITable, KPI/Insights tables, and any table with server-side data.
datatable.extends: ds-table — all base table rules apply (column order, row-actions, badges, empty state)

server_pagination.description: Pagination that fetches data from the server on page change. Never loads all rows upfront.
server_pagination.loading_state: Show skeleton rows (5 rows × columns) while fetching. Keep thead + pagination visible.

expand_rows.description: Expandable row with a nested detail panel. Clicking the row or a chevron reveals sub-content inline.
expand_rows.trigger: Chevron icon in leftmost column (after checkbox, before data columns). Toggles aria-expanded.
expand_rows.rule: Detail row spans all columns via colspan. Animate open/close with max-height transition.
expand_rows.css: .ds-tr-detail td { padding:0; } .ds-tr-detail-inner { padding:12px 16px 12px 48px; background:var(--shell-raised); border-bottom:1px solid var(--table-border); overflow:hidden; max-height:0; transition:max-height 200ms ease; } .ds-tr-expanded + .ds-tr-detail .ds-tr-detail-inner { max-height:400px; } .ds-expand-btn { width:20px; height:20px; border:none; background:transparent; color:var(--shell-text-muted); cursor:pointer; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; transition:transform 150ms; } .ds-tr-expanded .ds-expand-btn { transform:rotate(90deg); }
expand_rows.example_html: Row content Critical

column_header_controls.description: Sortable column headers. Add sort indicator icons. Never build column resize or reorder in HTML — those are TanStack/React-table concerns.
column_header_controls.sort_css: .ds-th-sortable { cursor:pointer; user-select:none; } .ds-th-sortable:hover { background:var(--shell-hover); } .ds-sort-icon { margin-left:4px; opacity:0.4; transition:opacity 100ms; } .ds-th-sortable:hover .ds-sort-icon,.ds-th-asc .ds-sort-icon,.ds-th-desc .ds-sort-icon { opacity:1; }
column_header_controls.example_html:
<th class="ds-th ds-th-sortable ds-th-asc" onclick="sortBy('name')">
  Name
  <svg class="ds-sort-icon" width="10" height="10" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><polyline points="18 15 12 9 6 15"/></svg>
</th>

react.library: TanStack Table (React Table v8) — handles pagination, sorting, expanding, virtualization, column resize
react.ds_integration: Use TanStack for data logic. Apply ds-table, ds-th, ds-td, ds-badge, row-actions CSS classes on TanStack-rendered elements.
react.note: Virtualization and column resize/reorder stay in TanStack — do not replicate in the DS. DS provides the visual layer only.

bulk_toolbar.position: Above table, replaces or overlays filter bar
bulk_toolbar.contents: Selected count + bulk action buttons (Delete, Export, etc.)
use_for: any list page with bulk operations

do: Always follow column order: checkbox → data → status → actions.
Keep actions in their own col-actions cell — never share with status.
Keep thead visible in empty and error states.
Use visibility:hidden on .row-actions, visibility:visible on tr:hover — never display:none.
dont: Never put action icons in the same <td> as the status badge.
Never use display:none on .row-actions — causes jumping. Never inline style='display:flex'.
Never hide thead in empty state.
Never use 🚧 in table empty state — always 🚦.
Never add a Refresh button in the empty state.
